content.text: The core implementation passes targeted checks for revisions, conflicts, causal witnesses, malformed device payloads, and concatenated Zstandard frames. The planner also matches an exhaustive oracle on 300 small randomized quota cases. The official public checker could not launch its child: this container’s inherited hard limits are below the child limits it requests. Both public fixtures pass when invoked directly.

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/stress_plan.py <<'PY'
import sys,time,random,resource
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/submission','/workspace/deps']
from common import validate
from planning import solve
random.seed(647)
n=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 4096
m=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 8192
pairs=262144
j={'version':3,'seed':'stress','leases':[{'id':'lease','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],
 'services':[{'id':'tcp','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[1],'captures':[], 'requests':[], 'offers':[],
 'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
for key in ['request_quotas','offer_quotas']:
 j[key].append({'id':'root','parent':None,'capacity':n})
 for i in range(127):j[key].append({'id':f'g{i}','parent':'root' if i==0 else f'g{(i-1)//2}','capacity':random.randint(n//20,n)})
for i in range(n):j['requests'].append({'id':f'r{i}','at':1,'lease':'lease','target':'2001:db8::1','service':'tcp','group':f'g{random.randrange(63,127)}'})
for i in range(m):j['offers'].append({'id':f'o{i}','time':2,'service':'tcp','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':random.randint(1,3),
 'cost':random.randint(0,10**9),'group':f'g{random.randrange(63,127)}','requests':[f'r{k}' for k in random.sample(range(n),min(n,pairs//m))]})
c=validate(j); start=time.monotonic();r=solve(c,{name:True for name in c['requests']})
print('stress',n,m,'time',time.monotonic()-start,'resolved',r['resolved'],'cost',r['cost'],'rss',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
PY
python3 -I -B /workspace/stress_plan.py
